# m6502.h

A cycle-stepped MOS 6502/6510 emulator in a single C header, by Andre
Weissflog, from the [chips](https://github.com/floooh/chips) project:

- File: `chips/m6502.h`
- Commit: `7ef8776f637a6424ac615da64de6b968b06de791`
- Licence: zlib, see the notice at the top of the file and
  [`LICENSES/Zlib.txt`](../../../../LICENSES/Zlib.txt).

Unmodified. The host tests in [`tools/cia/test`](../../test) use it to run
the Lorenz test suite against the 6526 model.
